issues.description: WebSocket hook modifies window.WebSocket to intercept and analyze outgoing/incoming messages. However, it does not transmit data to third-party servers, only analyzes local game traffic.
issues.recommendation: Ensure WebSocket interception is only for local analysis and does not transmit data externally.

summary: 该脚本未检测到数据外传、隐私采集、远程代码执行、代码混淆、DOM XSS、权限滥用、敏感 API 调用或供应链风险。唯一的安全注意点是 WebSocket hook 可能被滥用，但当前代码仅用于本地分析。整体安全风险较低。
